## Limitations: PMM

```{r}
#| include: false
a2_2_mm <- function(method, col) analysis2_marginal_matching[[col]][analysis2_marginal_matching$method == method]
```

<div style="font-size: 0.9em; line-height: 1.3;">

- **Most likely class misleads.** Assigning each person to their most likely class gives MCI `r a2_2_dec(a2_2_mm("PMM: most likely class", "MCI"), 1)`%, against `r a2_2_dec(a2_2_mm("Manly-Jones algorithm", "MCI"), 1)`% for the Manly-Jones algorithm. 
- **Lower three-class agreement.** Kappa with the Manly-Jones algorithm is `r a2_2_dec(a2_2_kappa_mj("PMM", "three_class_kappa"))` for the PMM (probability allocation) and `r a2_2_dec(a2_2_kappa_mj("Core algorithm", "three_class_kappa"))` for the core algorithm. Splitting each person across classes lowers kappa.

</div>
